extracted.name: Mayan Hot Chocolate
extracted.description: Cayenne pepper and cinnamon are added to instant hot chocolate mix to make this Mayan-style hot chocolate.
instruction_lines: Mix the hot chocolate mix, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper together in a mug.

Pour the milk into a glass measuring cup; heat in microwave on High until it begins to boil, about 2 minutes. Slowly pour over the mixture in the mug, stirring with a small whisk as you pour. Enjoy immediately.
